---
title: "Breeding system moderators"
format:
  html:
    toc: true
    toc-depth: 3
---

All results on this page use the models after exclusion of the two records for the common ostrich (6/6) and Nelson’s sparrow (8/8), whose exact counts could not be verified as broods with at least two genetic sires. Other records were retained, including the saltmarsh-sparrow record from the same Walsh study. Updated 5 November 2026.

Estimates are posterior means with 95% equal-tailed credible intervals (CrI). Odds ratios are summarised after exponentiating each contrast draw. Prevalence predictions are summarised after inverse-logit transformation, with random effects set to zero. Continuous effects use the original common scaling constants, retained unchanged after exclusion. Mixed paternity refers to the source-derived brood-level measure described in Methods; source reporting sometimes used brood-level EPP without identifying sire number.

## BG breeding system

603 records, 540 study identifiers and 366 species; 15884 mixed-paternity broods out of 45498 sampled broods.

| Coefficient | Mean log odds [95% CrI] | Mean OR [95% CrI] |
| --- | --- | --- |
| breeding systemcooperative breeder | -1.962 [-3.896, -0.033] | 0.229 [0.020, 0.967] |
| breeding systemlekking | -0.562 [-2.870, 1.736] | 1.136 [0.057, 5.675] |
| breeding systemmonogamy | -1.728 [-3.622, 0.162] | 0.283 [0.027, 1.176] |
| breeding systemno social bond | -0.755 [-2.802, 1.259] | 0.804 [0.061, 3.523] |
| breeding systempolyandry | -1.357 [-3.322, 0.617] | 0.426 [0.036, 1.853] |

| cooperative breeder - no social bond | -1.207 [-2.154, -0.278] | 0.336 [0.116, 0.757] |
| cooperative breeder - polyandry | -0.604 [-1.537, 0.314] | 0.610 [0.215, 1.368] |
| lekking - monogamy | 1.166 [-0.195, 2.527] | 4.097 [0.823, 12.519] |
| lekking - no social bond | 0.194 [-1.306, 1.673] | 1.616 [0.271, 5.327] |
| lekking - polyandry | 0.796 [-0.769, 2.322] | 3.012 [0.464, 10.199] |
| monogamy - no social bond | -0.973 [-1.816, -0.137] | 0.415 [0.163, 0.872] |
| monogamy - polyandry | -0.370 [-1.206, 0.464] | 0.756 [0.299, 1.591] |
| no social bond - polyandry | 0.602 [-0.511, 1.705] | 2.146 [0.600, 5.503] |
